column3: “Judgments I will speak” is rendered “discuss matters of justice.”
NASB has the archaic “seest”; “test my heart with you” is rendered “examine my heart’s attitude toward You.”
“Dry up” is rendered “mourn”; the verb has both senses.
“Land of safety” is rendered “land of peace.”
“Full” is rendered “cried aloud”; the meaning is uncertain.
